item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukraine has continued to use naval drones to strike Russian warships at Libya’s Benghazi port, prompting Zelensky to say Ukraine can attack wherever it wants. Russian forces have violated Finnish airspace with a helicopter and Polish airspace with an unmanned aerial vehicle, while Russia is reportedly preparing to place a nuclear weapon in space within 60 days, according to a German warning. The UN reports that civilian casualties in Ukraine in 2026 already far exceed previous years, and Zelensky has called for four-way peace talks with Russia, Europe and the US. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli forces continue strikes in Gaza, killing a UNRWA worker and others, while also cutting off vital hearing-aid supplies and approving sewage pumps that will discharge raw waste into the Mediterranean, worsening environmental damage described as a toxic wasteland. In the West Bank, Israeli checkpoints impede ambulance drivers and have become dangerous obstacles, and Israeli raids on refugee camps have led to dozens of detentions. Israeli incursions into southern Syria have triggered fear and destruction, extending the conflict beyond Gaza and the West Bank. The conflict has caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
Israeli forces demolished houses in southern Lebanon, withdrew and allowed villagers to return to damaged homes while Lebanese President Aoun warned Israel to pull back and cautioned Iran against interference. An IDF spokesperson visited a Lebanese school, sparking outrage and prompting an analyst to warn the move could push Lebanese Christians toward Hezbollah. Israel publicly sent best wishes to Lebanon on its Independence Day, which was observed quietly amid muted celebrations and ongoing drone activity over Beirut and strikes on southern Lebanese towns. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Yemen and the Red Sea: the situation
item.description:
Houthi forces have intensified attacks across Yemen, launching missiles from Saada toward Aden that fell in Dhamar and striking civilian vehicles in Lahj, killing a child and injuring three others, while a drone targeting the southern region was intercepted by the Saudi coalition in the Red Sea. Saudi-led coalition forces also intercepted a Houthi drone and a missile in western Yemen and struck a Houthi arms depot east of Taiz. The conflict continues to cause high civilian casualties, including dozens of children killed, and 918 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Uzbek fighters accuse Syrian security forces of harassment and enforced disappearances. item.title: Iraq: the situation
item.description:
Iraqi security forces have taken control of three checkpoints in Jurf al-Sakhar and reopened the Karbala road while Kataib Hezbollah begins a phased withdrawal from the area. The government and Egypt have agreed to scrap visa requirements and signed tax and cooperation deals, and the Iraqi prime minister is preparing a Cairo visit to deepen economic ties. Oil thefts have been reported across all governorates with estimated losses of $150 billion, and a gas pipeline fire at the Hartha power station near Basra killed at least four people and injured dozens. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Sudan's civil war: the situation
item.description:
RSF drones struck near Khartoum, killing four people and damaging a United Nations building, while another drone attack hit a residential area and a second UN facility in the capital. RSF ground forces attacked aid offices in Nyala and a shelter in West Kordofan, causing civilian casualties, and charity kitchens in Khartoum are closing, leaving displaced Sudanese, especially the elderly, in severe hardship. Sudanese doctors are urging aid agencies to rehabilitate a looted hospital in West Kordofan, and the Sennar state has resumed banana exports to Saudi Arabia after a multi-year halt. The conflict produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Somalia: the situation
item.description:

The United States conducted airstrikes against al-Shabaab at three locations in Somalia, and President Museveni of Uganda met with Somalia's President to discuss regional security and the transition of the African Union peacekeeping mission, while the Uganda army chief visited Somali troops amid a withdrawal from Barawe. Somalia warned that unrest in Ethiopia could weaken security operations involving the African Union mission. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

item.description:
President Paul Biya has finally announced a date for the long-delayed national elections, ending his prolonged absence from public view. The African Bar Association has called for mediation in the Anglophone crisis while the UN Human Rights Committee released findings on Cameroon’s situation. Nigeria, Cameroon, Chad and Niger have approved a 5 km cross-border military pursuit to combat terrorism, extending security operations beyond national borders. Ex-rebel fighters remain caught between hiding and broken promises, and activist Agbor Balla warned that a decade of bloodshed still prevents children from safely returning to school in the conflict zones.
